description: Get BuildFeed's weekly roundup content. Without a date, returns the index of available weekly roundups (most recent first) — useful for discovering which weeks exist. With a date (YYYY-MM-DD week key), returns that week's full roundup detail. Use this for "what happened this week" or historical week-by-week summary questions.

date.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) identifying a specific week. Omit to list available weeks.

limit.description: When listing weeks (no "date" given), max entries to return (default 20, hard cap 50).

name: get_weekly_roundup
